claims.title: Full refunds lose one cent
claims.explanation: The no-fee contract and JUnit assertion require 100 cents for a 100-cent refund; subtraction returns 99.
claims.suggested_remediation: Return the full amount under the stated contract.
assumptions: Scripted integration claim; no runtime execution.

claims.title: Scripted incorrect balance allegation
claims.explanation: This deliberate false-positive fixture alleges subtraction must add the refunded amount.
claims.suggested_remediation: This remediation is deliberately incorrect for scoring integration.
assumptions: Scripted integration claim; no runtime execution.

claims.title: Exact stock is rejected
claims.explanation: Strict greater-than returns false for 5 available and 5 requested although the declared contract permits it.
claims.suggested_remediation: Use an inclusive comparison and test equality.
assumptions: Scripted integration claim; no runtime execution.

claims.title: Deployment selector disagrees with pod labels
claims.explanation: The selector app value is jenkins-agent while the template has jenkins-worker.
claims.suggested_remediation: Align the declared selector and template labels; rendered behavior remains unverified.
assumptions: Scripted integration claim; no runtime execution.

claims.title: Push status success is treated as failure
claims.explanation: The library raises error for returnStatus zero and leaves nonzero unhandled in the captured publication path.
claims.suggested_remediation: Fail on nonzero status under the stated Jenkins contract.
assumptions: Scripted integration claim; no runtime execution.
